title: RAW UNREVIEWED: eclipse exposition nests an alternative location inside a necessary joint condition
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Jointly author ordinary phase and eclipse accounts: being near either lunar node is an alternative, but the required Sun-Moon phase must also hold. The source explicitly denies an eclipse at every full/new moon. Compare nested AND/OR, all-OR, and phase-only accounts without assigning any Voynich connector or celestial name.

design.production: An astronomical epitome compresses a causal exposition while retaining necessary conditions, alternatives and the explicit non-universal conclusion. Repeated short constructions can therefore express reusable logical relations rather than narrow seasonal names.
design.source: https://www.ghtc.usp.br/server/Sacrobosco-1478.htm — institutional Latin transcription of1478 Tractatus de sphaera ff27v-28r, from De eclipsi Lunae through the conclusion and Passion exception. This is the inspected edition layer, not a newly collated1420 witness.
design.source_content: The lunar explanation combines full moon with head/tail proximity; solar explanation combines conjunction with node proximity. Both reject every-phase eclipses. Exact/proximate position and observer differences remain distinct; the final miraculous exception is not a repair to natural conditions.
design.finite_contrast: For natural cases compare A: (HEAD or TAIL or permitted proximity) and PHASE; B: LOCATION or PHASE; C: PHASE alone. B/C wrongly make a phase-only case sufficient. A also differs from HEAD and TAIL, which demands simultaneous incompatible node locations. Unknown angular thresholds stay unknown.
design.existing_packet_to_author: The complete two f68r2 rings and full f89v1.13-20 paragraph already materialized in experiments/yolo/gdt1051_frozen_grammar_local_application/artifacts/RESULT.json. Draft both ring accounts together; the prose is a mandatory contextual burden, not presumed astronomical. No new extraction authorized. All three readers and upper-ring second-word disagreement retained.
design.positive_structure: GDT1051 preserves exact host oko versus ok and q/ch wrappers; GDT608 preserves directed composition and whole-form residuals. A shared nested construction must account for those differences instead of buying a separate sense at every occurrence.
design.meaning_rule: No current word assignments. Profile every eventual form first; a broadly frequent connector must retain its scope function across the existing full-context burden. An authored conjunction cannot count as independently observed truth.
design.predecessor: IDEA633 capacity decision and GDT1051 REPORT read.633 concerns opposite three-body occlusion relations and remains not tested;569 observer-frame reading remains failed in its exact extensions. This proposal's prospective contrast is nested alternative/necessary-condition syntax and an explicit phase-only negative, not a reopening of their image-edge test.
design.likely_failure: The rings may be too short to state the complete negative and positive clauses; the available paragraph may concern something else. Without written rejected cases or scope contrast all candidates may remain equivalent. No diagrams are declared eclipses from appearance alone.
design.next_step: Author one shared finite construction for the two complete rings, retaining every unknown and the full paragraph obligations; stop if the negative case can only be added as unwritten commentary. No classifier, search over new pages or decoder.
